title: Runtime Observation Materialization Input
description: A versioned, run-scoped, offline gate input that converts six future, individually human-authorized live-canary short-text observations into the existing runtime candidate handoff. The materializer never performs network access, never runs a canary, never selects, and never produces any output when a single gate fails. The output contract is exclusively the existing runtime-candidate-handoff Schema; this document defines only the gated input.

materialization_id.description: Stable identifier for this finite, offline materialization run.

handoff_id.description: Identifier forwarded verbatim to the produced runtime candidate handoff.

source_observations.description: Exactly six distinct, individually authorized completed-canary observations.

outcome.description: Only a completed single-page canary may be materialized.

reason_code.description: The exact completion reason code of the bounded live canary.

http_status.description: Only a clean 200 observation is eligible; any block, challenge, or redirect is ineligible.

observed_url.description: Must equal source_locator exactly; a redirect makes the observation ineligible.

short_text.description: Only the two authorized sanitized short-text fields. HTML, DOM, cookies, scripts, media, query values, exception text, and browser state are structurally rejected.

confirmed_by.description: A human record label; agent and model identities are rejected by the materializer.

authorization_reference.description: One independent per-source authorization reference; the six references must be pairwise distinct.

HumanAuthorization.description: One independent, per-source, per-run human authorization. It is a gate record, not a license, permission, clearance, or VERIFIED claim.
